metadata.name: ydelta
metadata.description: Quote-only fixed-rate lending on Solana. 45 instructions, tags 0..=44. Instruction data is borsh-encoded after a 1-byte tag header. State accounts are bytemuck `#[repr(C)]` Pod — NOT borsh — so account decoders live in `ts/src/accounts/` and read raw byte offsets. v1 adds a two-sided order book: borrowers rest bids (tags 42/44 cancel/update, tag 4 residual-mode rest) and sub-vaults rest asks (tags 12/14), crossed by a permissionless match crank (tag 43).
